prompt:
Our enterprise DataOps team needs a security audit of all automation modules in the 'DataOps' category that have sufficient credibility to be considered for production use. We only care about modules that meet a credibility threshold of 60 or above — anything below that is not worth our time.

For each candidate module, run a full security vetting scan. Capture the results — especially which modules passed and which failed — in a consolidated report file called `vetting_report.json`.

Also produce a formatted catalog export (in Markdown) for just the DataOps category, so our team can circulate it in our documentation wiki.

We need this done today. The discovery, scanning, and reporting should all be done programmatically using the tools available in this workspace.
